items.title: Sources: Tigers stay busy, reach 1-year, $25M deal with RHP Gausman

items.title: Sources: Twins, reliever Ginkel agree to 2-year, $18 million deal

items.title: Sources: Orioles to bring OF Robert back on 1-year deal

items.title: Free agent Bohm reaches 2-year deal with Royals, reports say

items.title: Source: Marlins agree to 1-year deal with catcher Sanchez
